nodes.label: MARQ (Marquee Achievement & Readiness Quotient)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for the Top Notch Marquee Training Programme; every number comes from a recorded event, nothing estimated.

nodes.label: One-time invite link & self-set password
nodes.rationale: Nobody types or receives a password from someone else.

nodes.label: Application lifecycle statuses
nodes.rationale: Every change keeps previous status, who changed it, when and why - nothing is overwritten; custom statuses addable in Settings.

nodes.label: Attendance change request / Director approval
nodes.rationale: Nobody can approve their own request; rejected requests leave the record unchanged.

nodes.label: Append-only audit log
nodes.rationale: Records imports, registrations, attendance, marks, application statuses and role changes with who, when, before/after and IP.

nodes.label: Daily attendance register
nodes.rationale: Follows the college sheet layout; posted once per day then locked so only the Director can approve changes.

nodes.label: Data isolation
nodes.rationale: Students only load their own record; changing a link or ID returns not found; mentors see only assigned students.

nodes.label: Permission + scope check on every call
nodes.norm_label: permission + scope check on every call
nodes.rationale: Hiding a button is never the only protection: server re-checks permission (module x action) and scope (whole programme, assigned students, own record) on every request.

nodes.label: Score calculation (dimensions, Overall & Readiness)
nodes.rationale: Missing data shows '-' and is never counted as zero; weighted averages over dimensions that have data; weights editable in Settings.

nodes.label: Student self-registration & mandatory onboarding
nodes.rationale: Only emails already on the Top Notch list accepted; activation link goes only to the student's inbox; coding profiles and profile mandatory before the portal opens.
